question: When full, streams flow everywhere; by what force does this occur?
premises: The full state produces streams everywhere.
The question asks which ones flow thus.
inference: The verse challenges whether only some streams move by their own nature.
uncertainties: The exact referent of saiṣā is context-dependent.
plain_english: When that is full, streams flow in every direction; indeed, what and which ones flow thus by the force of their own nature?
